title: inference-domain-probes-report-to-the-watch
intention: Every standing WATCHME probe berthed in cairn/devices/inference_domain reports to harbor_master's watch verb with {ticket, holds, finding} stated against its own ticket's falsifier, and each spec names that receiver.
why: Every standing probe in cairn/devices/inference_domain mails harbor_master or inference_domain with no verb and nothing reads it (835b5736bf2b D2); a88d6a368cfb built the watch verb that uses a WATCHME finding and 8ecb99998254 built watch_carry. Akien's answer to open-291189a9766a: build the receivers.
traces_to: 835b5736bf2b's falsifier (zero probe-bearing standing specs lack a receiver) and Akien's answer to open-291189a9766a ('for all watchmes that we built probes for but not recievers, i think we just build the recievers'); the 2026-09-30 ruling that a probe's data must have a consumer that USES it; RULE 1 (the build stays inside cairn/devices/inference_domain; base's helper through its public interface, harbor_master through its bus verb)
how: Measured 2026-10-03: 8 tickets at PROVED carry a watchme probe under cairn/devices/inference_domain/probes (7397b8442b85, d6d20400441f, 548dd13fb4db, fd5331d3879a, 042b131b7d6c, 2ff6113705be, 9127dd2a0ff4, 6bcfb70c6f57). Every trigger is TRUE when the falsifier fails (the first offending row, a broken identity, a disagreement), so each PROBE gets verb='watch' and carry=watch_carry(<its id>, _carry, fails=_trigger), importing watch_carry from cairn.tools.base.probe (declared public). Three post to='inference_domain' (548dd13fb4db, fd5331d3879a, 042b131b7d6c); inference_domain declares no recorder and no receive override, so that mail has no reader, and they retarget to='harbor_master'. Each ticket's watchme spec gains receiver {what: 'harbor_master watch verb', in: 'cairn/devices/cairn/machines/harbor_master'} through the artifact door. A proof under cairn/devices/inference_domain/proofs reads the population from the commons and asserts each probe's verb, to, and live payload invariants.
falsifier: GREEN when every ticket at PROVED or WATCHME whose watchme.probe sits under cairn/devices/inference_domain has a probe whose PROBE posts verb 'watch' to 'harbor_master' and whose payload over live data carries ticket == that ticket's id, holds a bool, and a non-empty finding whenever holds is False; and every such spec names receiver {what: 'harbor_master watch verb', in: 'cairn/devices/cairn/machines/harbor_master'} with watchme_spec_error naming no receiver fault. RED if any standing inference_domain spec lacks the receiver, if a converted payload's ticket is a path or another id, or if a probe still posts to inference_domain. WRONG INTENT if an inference_domain probe's data has a reader other than its own ticket's FIXME that only Akien could name.
watchme: none, because what this child's probes say is read by harbor_master's watch verb (a88d6a368cfb, PROVED), and whether they ever fire is 164da559823d's and acb4ecd84364's watch (CairnCommons/tickets/164da559823d-*.json); a probe on probes reporting would need a receiver of its own.
children: none, because the change is 8 PROBE declarations and their specs, all inside cairn/devices/inference_domain.
builder_notes: A Haiku builder would ask: (1) Which probes and how: all 8 use fails=_trigger — 7397b8442b85 a_non_final_answer_is_refused_by_name (to harbor_master), d6d20400441f the_ticket_comes_back_whole (to harbor_master), 548dd13fb4db an_agent_retry_gets_a_fresh_sample (to inference_domain), fd5331d3879a an_inference_call_logs_that_it_started (to inference_domain), 042b131b7d6c the_meter_accounts_for_every_verdict (to inference_domain), 2ff6113705be does_a_domain_ride_the_request (to harbor_master), 9127dd2a0ff4 a_refused_ask_leaves_a_row (to harbor_master), 6bcfb70c6f57 does_the_route_leave_loopback (to harbor_master). In each file: add watch_carry to the existing 'from cairn.tools.base.probe import ...' line; add a module constant _TICKET_ID = '<id>' after the imports; in PROBE = Probe(...) replace 'carry=_carry,' with "verb='watch'," and 'carry=watch_carry(_TICKET_ID, _carry, fails=_trigger),'; and for 548dd13fb4db, fd5331d3879a, 042b131b7d6c change to='inference_domain' to to='harbor_master'. Nothing else in the probe changes. (2) watch_carry already exists in cairn/tools/base/probe.py (8ecb99998254); do not edit it. (3) Specs: each of the 8 tickets' watchme spec whose probe starts with cairn/devices/inference_domain/probes/ gains receiver {what: 'harbor_master watch verb', in: 'cairn/devices/cairn/machines/harbor_master'}, written through cairn.tools.artifact.artifact.write(path, text, verb='cast', why=...). (4) Proof: cairn/devices/inference_domain/proofs/test_inference_probes_report_to_the_watch.py, PROVES {'8d3c36e1fe59': {'all': 'test_inference_probes_report_to_the_watch'}}; it reads the population from the commons (tickets at PROVED/WATCHME whose watchme probe starts with cairn/devices/inference_domain/probes/, rooted at the main tree when run in a worktree, as 8ecb's proof does), and its teeth are every_standing_inference_probe_posts_watch (verb, to, live payload invariants), every_standing_inference_spec_names_the_receiver, and the composite. (5) Every other inference_domain proof that imports a converted probe stays green: run them.

decisions.text: D1: the 8 probes — In each of these files under cairn/devices/inference_domain/probes/: a_non_final_answer_is_refused_by_name.py (7397b8442b85), the_ticket_comes_back_whole.py (d6d20400441f), an_agent_retry_gets_a_fresh_sample.py (548dd13fb4db), an_inference_call_logs_that_it_started.py (fd5331d3879a), the_meter_accounts_for_every_verdict.py (042b131b7d6c), does_a_domain_ride_the_request.py (2ff6113705be), a_refused_ask_leaves_a_row.py (9127dd2a0ff4), does_the_route_leave_loopback.py (6bcfb70c6f57) — append watch_carry to the existing `from cairn.tools.base.probe import ...` line, add `_TICKET_ID = "<its id>"` after the import block, and in `PROBE = Probe(...)` replace `carry=_carry,` with `verb="watch",` and `carry=watch_carry(_TICKET_ID, _carry, fails=_trigger),`. In an_agent_retry_gets_a_fresh_sample.py, an_inference_call_logs_that_it_started.py, the_meter_accounts_for_every_verdict.py also change to="inference_domain" to to="harbor_master". Nothing else changes; watch_carry is not edited.

D2: the retarget in the agent-retry proof — cairn/devices/inference_domain/proofs/test_the_agent_retry_probe_judges.py line 88 asserts p.to == 'inference_domain' with message 'a probe berths with WHAT IT WATCHES'; the berth is the file's location, which does not move, while `to` is the receiver, which 835b5736bf2b D2 names as harbor_master. Change it to assert p.to == 'harbor_master' and p.verb == 'watch' with message 'the probe berths with what it watches and reports to harbor_master's watch verb (8d3c36e1fe59)'. Then run every proof under cairn/devices/inference_domain/proofs that imports a probe (test_watch_probe, test_inference_domain, test_groundloop_pulse, test_watch_domain_probe, test_task_ticket, test_the_agent_retry_probe_judges, test_an_inference_call_logs_that_it_started, test_watch_refused_probe); each must read green, and their seals are retaken.

D3: the proof — Create cairn/devices/inference_domain/proofs/test_inference_probes_report_to_the_watch.py, modeled on cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_base_probes_report_to_the_watch.py, PROVES = {'8d3c36e1fe59': {'all': 'test_inference_probes_report_to_the_watch'}}, BERTH = 'cairn/devices/inference_domain/probes/', _main_tree() rooting for the commons. Teeth: every_standing_inference_probe_posts_watch (population: tickets at PROVED or WATCHME whose watchme.probe starts with BERTH; verb == 'watch', to == 'harbor_master', payload({}) has ticket == the id, holds a bool, a non-empty finding when holds is False — invariants only); every_standing_inference_spec_names_the_receiver (receiver == {'what': 'harbor_master watch verb', 'in': 'cairn/devices/cairn/machines/harbor_master'} and watchme_spec_error names no receiver fault); and the composite test_inference_probes_report_to_the_watch calling both.

D4: the specs' receiver — For each of the 8 tickets in D1, add watchme['receiver'] (the dict above) to the spec whose probe starts with BERTH, via cairn.tools.artifact.artifact.write(path, text, verb='cast', why='<id>: the watchme names its receiver, harbor_master's watch verb (8d3c36e1fe59)').

D5: green, then commit — Run cairn/devices/inference_domain/proofs/test_inference_probes_report_to_the_watch.py (exit 0), seal it and the retaken proofs, commit the probes and proofs with message '8d3c36e1fe59: inference_domain probes report to the watch' in the background (the commit runs the reseal ladder); commit the commons.
